subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporters, We are excited to invite you to our annual charity gala, where we will celebrate another year of making a positive impact in our community. Join us for an evening of dinner, entertainment, and fundraising for our important causes. Your presence and support mean a lot to us, and we hope to see you there. Please RSVP by the end of the week to secure your spot. Thank you for being a part of our mission. Sincerely, The Charity Foundation Team
